themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Far-right and right-wing parties across Europe and the Americas are intensifying their focus on anti-immigration policies in response to perceived border crises. This theme is evident in countries like Spain, Italy, Germany, and the UK, where parties are demanding stricter controls, deportations, and healthcare restrictions for migrants.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands immediate deportation of migrants in Ceuta and healthcare restrictions for non-critical cases.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italy's government faces criticism for returning asylum seekers to countries like Austria and Germany under EU migration pacts.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Calls for stricter border controls and opposes healthcare access for undocumented migrants.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposes policies to deter illegal immigration, including welfare restrictions for foreign nationals.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Advocates for stricter border controls and faster deportations to deter illegal immigration.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox (Andalusia)
countries.note: Criticizes government for housing migrants in local towns and demands stricter enforcement of immigration laws.

themes.title: Far-right parties gain ground in regional and national elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties are making significant electoral gains across Europe, particularly in Germany, Sweden, and Italy. These parties are leveraging internal divisions within traditional parties and capitalizing on voter dissatisfaction with mainstream governance.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, threatening to form state governments.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Aims to become Sweden's largest party and potentially lead the opposition or government.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Faces internal divisions but remains a key player in Italy's right-wing coalition government.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Gains traction in local elections and prepares for the 2027 presidential race.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Leads Norwegian polls, positioning itself as a kingmaker in potential coalition governments.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing governments in the US, Argentina, Poland, and the UK are pushing for cuts to social programs, citing fiscal responsibility. These policies often face opposition from left-wing parties and civil society groups, leading to heated debates over economic priorities.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Proposes cuts to federal grants for teen pregnancy prevention and Head Start programs.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Implements austerity measures, including cuts to social programs and deregulation of industries.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Criticizes government tax proposals as insufficient and advocates for higher tax-free thresholds.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposes £50 billion in welfare cuts, targeting benefits for foreign nationals and unemployed youth.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders face internal party divisions and leadership challenges
themes.blurb: Internal divisions and leadership challenges are plaguing right-wing parties across Europe and the Americas. In Italy, the Lega faces calls for Matteo Salvini's resignation, while in Argentina, Javier Milei's government grapples with infighting and corruption scandals involving key advisors.

themes.title: Right-wing parties target LGBTQ+ rights and gender policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties in the US, Poland, UK, Spain, and Italy are intensifying their opposition to LGBTQ+ rights and gender policies. These parties are pushing for legislation that restricts gender identity recognition, limits access to gender-affirming care, and opposes inclusive education policies.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Proposes policies restricting gender identity recognition and access to gender-affirming care.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Criticizes government policies on gender and LGBTQ+ rights, advocating for traditional values.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Opposes inclusive education policies and advocates for traditional gender roles.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes gender equality plans and advocates for traditional family values.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Faces internal debates over gender policies, with some factions advocating for traditional values.
